title: RxCode — Plan the big idea. Let your agents ship it.
excerpt: Sprint boards, automatic agent routing, schedules, briefings and chat for your team of AI coding agents — on Mac, server and mobile.
content_html:
Newv2.0.0 is out — see what's new

RxCode is the native workspace for teams of AI agents. Sprint boards, automatic agent routing, schedules, briefings and chat — on your Mac, your server, and in your pocket.

Download for macOSv2.0.0 · 56.4 MBStar on GitHub

Free & open source · macOS 26+ · iOS · Android

Works with the agents you already use

Automatic routing

The right-sized agent for every task.

RxCode reads each card's scope and routes it to the agent and model that fit — quick fixes go to fast models, deep refactors go to the heavy hitters. You save tokens without losing quality.

Agent team

Plan your next big idea. Your agent team breaks it down, picks the most efficient agent for each piece, and finishes it fast and clean.

New idea

Plan · 4 tasks

Shipped in parallel4 agents · 18 min

Schedule · Briefing · Chat

From coding to living.
All in one place.

ScheduleBriefingChat

Flowcy Cloud

Your team's
cloud workspace.

Flowcy brings your boards, agents and people together. Invite your team, assign work to humans or agents, and let every device pick up where the last one left off.

Shared cloud boards

One workspace for every project, synced to every teammate and every device.

Runs on the right machine

Cloud tasks are claimed by exactly one device, so work never runs twice.

Secrets stay secret

Encrypted on-device with passkeys. The cloud never sees plaintext.

Releases, CI & docs

Ship releases, watch CI, review dependency updates and publish docs together.

Explore Flowcy

Every agent, one workspace

Bring the agents you love.

Claude Code and Codex are built in. Antigravity, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and any Agent Client Protocol runtime install from the ACP registry in one click — same chat, approvals and board.

0 / 9 agents online

Local fine-tuning

Your data trains
your own model.

Fine-tune a local model on the work you've already done, then let it process tasks the way you would. Private by default.

  1. 1Collect locallyThreads, diffs and task reviews you already have become training data, right on your Mac.
  2. 2Fine-tune on deviceA lightweight adapter trains on Apple silicon. Nothing is uploaded, nothing leaves the machine.
  3. 3Process tasks offlineYour tuned model picks up routine tasks in your style, with zero API cost and no network.

24H on call

Agents on your side.
On call 24 hours.

While you sleep, your agents watch CI, triage new issues, review dependency updates and keep schedules running. When you wake up, the fixes and a briefing are waiting.

22:00You're asleep

From idea to shipped.
RxCode has it all.

Free and open source. Download v2.0.0 and put your agent team to work.
